text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab Shipbuilding and Repair Yard Company enjoys record repair sales of $89.5 million in 1996.
- Bahrain Promotions and Marketing Board launches a $1 million campaign to attract Gulf Arab tourists.
- Bahraini delegation to visit Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan to explore trade opportunities.
- Bahrain Telecommunications Company posts 28.1 million dinar net profit in 1996.
- A Bahraini ministerial committee will visit main seaports in the Far East to find the best design for a new seaport to be built in Bahrain.
